messages:
Carlos M: Heads-up — planning a dry-run for the Snowflake + Databricks edge connector (Qdrant & Milvus targets) ahead of the marketplace listing. Proposed Thu 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Can SI, QA, and Eng-Infra confirm availability?
Lina T: I can own the SI checklist and packaging. Need to know preferred package format (helm chart), sample Delta table & Snowpipe config, and whether we publish wheel artifacts.
Evan S: QA available Thu AM. Please provide test vectors: schema variants, large payloads, and malformed-row cases. Also define acceptance criteria.
Carlos M: Acceptance criteria (draft): deploy via helm, ingest 500 msgs over 5 minutes with no crashes, dedup works, schema-drift fallback to raw column, end-to-end latency <1s for ~1KB rows.
Lina T: We'll include a values.yaml example and install script snippet in the runbook. Plan to add an operator CR for field mappings and a vector backend selector.
Evan S: For the soak I need kube context and service-account RBAC. Tag me when staging cluster + creds are ready.
Carlos M: Security note: the marketplace package must not include customer keys. Confirm KMS integration docs and check export-control flags. Ping legal for confirmation.
partnerships-bot: Action created: "dryrun-runbook" assigned to @Lina T, due 2026-04-01 10:00.
Alex R: Databricks note: if using Delta Live Tables we need cluster init scripts to install connector deps (wheel or pip). For Snowflake, Snowpipe setup requires either an external stage + notifications or time-limited tokens — include both patterns.
Lina T: We'll include init scripts + wheel artifact publishing instructions and a sample CI job that pushes artifacts to partner S3.
Carlos M: Also need a short customer-facing blurb for the marketplace listing: 2-3 bullets covering features, supported backends, and deployment modes.
Priya N: I can draft the listing blurb. Send feature bullets by EOD and I9ll have a first pass.
Evan S: Quick smoke command we'll use for ingest tests (staging):
```
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/partner_token)
curl -s -X POST https://edge-gw.staging/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @tests/soak_payload.json
```
Lina T: Implementation note: vector backends supported in this run are Qdrant and Milvus. We support batch upsert mode; default HELM value vector.batchSize=256.
Carlos M: Next steps: Lina produce runbook + helm values (due Wed EOD), Evan run soak Thu AM and post results here, Alex prepare init scripts and artifact publishing path, Priya draft listing blurb. Legal to confirm export controls before any external announcement.
Priya N: Draft listing location: drive.redwood.com/partnerships/edge-listing-draft (will add access).
Alex R: I'll post cluster init script path and RBAC snippet in this thread by Tue.
Evan S: If I hit blockers during soak I'll escalate to eng-ops and post logs here.
Carlos M: Thanks all. If schedule changes, update thread. :thumbsup:
